title: Pentagon’s UFO Hunter Reveals Himself and What He Learned, Including the Video He Can’t Forget (Exclusive)
description: “I can literally still see that video in my head,” Stratton recalls in this week’s issue of PEOPLE. In the clip, he says, was what looked like a black triangular craft with orange, white and yellow lights glowing on each corner. It moved silently before seeming to defy the laws of physics by accelerating faster than the eye could follow — and was gone. “That,” says Stratton, “was the moment that changed my world.”

title: 'Something From a Different Universe': New Jersey UFO Footage Shows Blinding Light and Strange Protrusion
description: A paranormal YouTuber has examined unverified footage of a bright object over New Jersey, reviving claims about unusual drones while acknowledging that perspective may explain its appearance.

title: Did AI Come From Aliens? Deep Prasad Links Roswell UFO Crash to Modern Technology Breakthroughs
description: Quantum computing entrepreneur Deep Prasad has suggested that alleged technology recovered from the 1947 Roswell incident may have accelerated developments behind modern AI, though no evidence supports the claim.
